title: Berd Sparrow50 Gold: The Fastest and Smoothest Gravel Wheels in the World
content:
The Sparrow50 Gold was designed by Berd to be the most aerodynamic and vibration-damping wheelset the gravel world has ever seen. In their white paper, they explain the physics of gravel riding and quantify both aerodynamics and vibration damping to show these wheels beat every rival across all gravel courses.

Berd Sparrow50 Quick Hits

  • Rim Material: Carbon Fiber
  • Internal Rim Width: 30 mm
  • Rim Depth: 50 mm
  • External Rim Width: 38 mm
  • Available in 29″ (700c) and 32″
  • Tubeless Compatible
  • Rim Weight 420 grams (29″) 540 grams (32″)
  • Angle Matched Spoke Holes
  • Hole Count 24 Holes Front and Rear
  • Center lock disc rotors
  • Weight 32:
    • Wheelset Weight 1,541 grams (without rim tape and valves)
    • Front Wheel Weight 718 grams (without rim tape and valves)
    • Rear Wheel Weight 823 grams (without rim tape and valves)
  • Weight 29:
    • Wheelset Weight 1,298 grams (without rim tape and valves)
    • Front Wheel Weight 600 grams (without rim tape and valves)
    • Rear Wheel Weight 698 grams (without rim tape and valves)
  • E-Bike Approved Yes, up to 60 Nm/500 W
  • Weight Limit 280 lbs / 127 kg
  • Hand Laced in Hopkins, MN, Trued by TRUDI
  • Warranty Limited Lifetime Warranty and Free Crash Replacement

Optimized for Aerodynamics

Compatible with 40 mm to 60 mm tires and optimized in the wind tunnel with 45 mm to 55 mm tires in close collaboration with Schwalbe. The Schwalbe G-One RS PRO in 45 mm is the fastest, most aerodynamic tire we have tested for Category 1 (hard-packed) gravel.

Wide Internal Rim Width

The Sparrow50 Gold wheels are tubeless-ready with a 30 mm internal rim width. A super wide 4 mm hooked bead locks the tire in place for confident retention with all tire types and protection against pinch flats at low pressure.

Unmatched Smoothness

Berd spokes are the only spokes that use viscoelastic damping to dissipate high-frequency vibration, absorbing energy from gravel through time-dependent strain relaxation in the fiber. No steel spoke can do it.

Find out more at Berd Spokes.
